reason: A DeepSeek Harness Web plugin that integrates an external voting service, allowing users to submit a daily vote and view scores, distributions, and recent trends through an input-bar widget.

summaries.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框底栏提供梁值投票控件，并同步显示评分、分布和近30天趋势。
summaries.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness web input-bar widget for daily voting and for viewing synchronized scores, distributions, and 30-day trends.

capabilities: Reads voting status from an external service
Submits a user-selected daily vote to an external service
Reads score and trend data from a public results endpoint
Displays voting controls, scores, distributions, and 30-day trends in the web UI
Refreshes result data periodically from a CDN
